purpose: TransformerPath Design Engine configuration. This is the ARCHITECTURE (class catalogue, workflow, module applicability, validation states, honest positioning). It documents what is structured for each transformer class. It does NOT assert that the physics for any class is complete or validated. Per-class engineering modules remain BETA / ENGINEERING REVIEW until they pass benchmark validation (see check-design.js). No module is released as IEC/IEEE compliant, certified, or FEM/CFD-validated.

classes.label: Autotransformer
classes.topology_note: Common + series winding; power transfer and impedance relationships differ from a two-winding transformer.

classes.label: Shunt reactor
classes.topology_note: Gapped core / air-gap design; not a two-winding loaded transformer. Dedicated MVAr/inductance/reactance module.

classes.label: Arc-furnace transformer
classes.topology_note: Very high secondary current, frequent cycling, harmonics — furnace-duty corrections required; power-transformer assumptions must not be reused without correction.

classes.label: Rectifier transformer
classes.topology_note: Pulse number, multi-secondary, phase displacement, harmonic/k-factor loss effects — not sinusoidal two-winding.

classes.label: Converter transformer
classes.topology_note: HVDC / industrial, harmonics, phase shift, DC bias, insulation stress — not claimed until validated.

classes.label: Phase-shifting transformer
classes.topology_note: Exciting + series transformer; an own topology.

validation_states.label: Pass
validation_states.meaning: Check performed and within the set limit / tolerance.

validation_states.label: Review
validation_states.meaning: Check performed; result is outside a soft limit or needs an engineering decision.

validation_states.label: Warning
validation_states.meaning: Check performed; result is outside a hard limit or indicates a likely issue.

validation_states.label: Not calculated
validation_states.meaning: This module/check has not been run for this class. It is NOT a pass.

validation_states.label: Insufficient data
validation_states.meaning: A required input is missing/unknown; no state is asserted.

revision_model: Preserve inputs, assumptions, calculation basis, revision and results per design. Each important output is traceable to its input/calculation.
